verdict.rationale: Claude Code is a developer tool with an Agent SDK, so an interactive API reference is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence pack only shows overview docs, an llms.txt index and markdown versions of doc pages. Nothing documents an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and machine-readable docs are an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
